sentences.text: The ACT Integrity Commission considered a parliamentary committee’s corruption complaint about acquisitions for the City to the Lake Project.
sentences.support: the Commission commenced an investigation of each acquisition pursuant to s 100

sentences.text: This report examined the West Basin acquisitions and the use of former agency executives as consultants.
sentences.support: This Special Report deals with the Commission’s consideration of the remainder

sentences.text: The Commission decided to discontinue the investigations because further action on the corruption report was not justified.
sentences.support: the Commission has determined that the investigation must be discontinued in accordance with s 112(1)

notes: No standalone executive summary identified. Criticisms attributed to the Auditor-General and parliamentary committee are not presented as Commission findings. Existing OPAX findings mean no additional findings quotes.
